This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.


Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - Earlier requests:
     - Review JusPrin's menus against agent-docs and list the items that don't fit (done).
     - Kenneth then decided:
       - Hide Help › Keyboard Shortcuts, Troubleshoot Center, Open Network Test, Benchmark 3D Scene and Migrate Filament Presets.
       - Hide View › Show IDEX/IQEX Toolhead and Show all collision volumes.
       - Hide Preset Bundle.
       - Hide the sliced-file exports.
       - File › Export keeps "just 1 export" plus "a way to export gcode". When asked, he picked Project 3MF over Generic 3MF, and the header's export item becomes Export G-code.
     - "re-examine the whole thing if necessary by launching the app afterwards."
     - "launch the app so that I can check" (done; Mac scratch copy pid 33627).
   - CURRENT request: "commit to a feature branch. then run it on gcp jusprin-win-test and give me the screenshots for me to confirm"
     - The commit is done.
     - The Windows run is in progress; screenshots are being captured.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - How AppMenus (fork-owned) rearranges OrcaSlicer's wxMenus:
     - `arrange()` and `without()` place and remove items.
     - `stock_item()` finds an item by label.
     - A new `stock_keyed_item()` matches labels that end with kShownKey plus a rebindable key.
   - wx update-UI ordering: a handler bound later runs first. AppMenus binds wxEVT_UPDATE_UI on the frame for an OrcaSlicer item and doesn't Skip, so it overrides OrcaSlicer's always-true condition.
   - The Mac hides Quit in the File menu, so no separator before it.
   - The Edit menu title uses `_L_CONTEXT("Edit", "Menu")`.
   - Plater::export_gcode(false) writes .gcode. EVT_GLTOOLBAR_EXPORT_SLICED_FILE writes .gcode.3mf.
   - Generic 3MF uses export_3mf with Silence. Project 3MF uses SplitModel|ShareMesh|Silence.
   - Reading the live Mac menus through the AX JXA script `dump_menus.js` (reads properties in bulk), clicking with `click_menu.js`, and the MCP workspace_inspect plate count through `inspect.py` (uses tests/mcp/probe.py `call`).
   - Windows VM jusprin-win-test:
     - Project elegoo-backend, zone us-central1-a, IP 34.135.245.169.
     - winssh.sh and winscp.sh in /Users/kenneth/jusprin-win-vm-harness.
     - UI actions run as a scheduled task with Interactive logon as guitest.
     - Mesa: mesa\opengl32.dll plus libgallium_wgl.dll, with GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe and LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1.
   - After the 2.5.0 merge, Windows builds use build_win.bat. I configured cmake manually instead.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Shell/AppMenus.cpp** (committed in e0ba67ea68):
     - Added `#include <wx/event.h>`.
     - Added `stock_keyed_item`:
       ```cpp
       wxMenuItem* stock_keyed_item(wxMenu* menu, const wxString& label)
       {
           const wxString text = wxStripMenuCodes(label);
           for (wxMenuItem* item : menu->GetMenuItems())
               if (!item->IsSeparator() && (item->GetItemLabelText() == text || item->GetItemLabelText().StartsWith(text + kShownKey)))
                   return item;
           throw std::runtime_error(...);
       }
       ```
     - In install(), after build_help, Duplicate Current Plate is greyed on Home:
       ```cpp
       {
       #ifdef __APPLE__
           wxMenu* edit = bar_menu(m_frame, _L_CONTEXT("Edit", "Menu"));
       #else
           wxMenu* edit = top_submenu(m_frame, _L_CONTEXT("Edit", "Menu"));
       #endif
           const int id = stock_item(edit, _L("Duplicate Current Plate"))->GetId();
           m_frame.Bind(wxEVT_UPDATE_UI, &AppMenus::on_update_ui, this, id);
           m_bound.emplace_back(edit, id);
           m_commands.emplace(id, Command{{}, [this] { return !home(); }});
       }
       ```
     - Windows title-bar list now leaves out Sync Presets, Preset Bundle, Open Speed Dial and Plugins.
     - build_file:
       - The Mac preset_bundle item was removed.
       - `arrange(exports, {project, separator(exports), stock_item(exports, _L("Export G-code") + dots)});`
       - The separator before quit is added only off the Mac.
     - build_view leaves out G-code Window (keyed), Reset Window Layout, Show IDEX/IQEX Toolhead and Show all collision volumes (keyed).
     - build_help leaves out Keyboard Shortcuts (keyed), Setup Wizard, Migrate Filament Presets, Troubleshoot Center, Open Network Test, Benchmark 3D Scene and Show Tip of the Day.
     - build_print dropped the Export action. Its comment reads "The header's Export G-code… is in File › Export."
   - **src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Shell/StatusRow.cpp**:
     - `can_export = plate->is_slice_result_ready_for_export() && !m_plater.is_export_gcode_scheduled();`
     - The label is "Export G-code…".
     - `case PrintAction::Export: m_plater.export_gcode(false); return;`
   - **tests/shell/shell_harness.cpp**:
     - Added `has_label_starting`.
     - File menu expectation: Mac has no "---" before quit.
     - New check `app_menus_export_is_project_3mf_and_gcode`. The Print menu expectation has no Export item.
     - Help and View checks confirm the hidden items are absent.
     - The Windows title-bar expectation is {Edit, View, Print, Printer, Preferences, ---, Help}.
     - New check `app_menus_edit_greys_out_duplicate_plate_on_home`.
     - The header check looks for "Export G-code…".
   - **Commit:** e0ba67ea68 "App menus: hide OrcaSlicer items that don't fit JusPrin, and one export each for the project and the G-code", on branch claude/menu-trim.
     - Worktree: /Users/kenneth/Projects/JusPrin/.claude/worktrees/app-menus.
     - Message file: scratchpad/commit-msg2.txt.
     - Not pushed.
   - **Memory** app-menu-decisions.md: added the 2026-11-11 trim decisions.
   - **Mac scratchpad** (/private/tmp/claude/claude-502/-Users-kenneth-Projects-JusPrin/d8244453-3b6f-47fb-8616-225c4fd669d3/scratchpad):
     - Scripts: dump_menus.js, dump_one.js, click_menu.js, inspect.py.
     - App copy: walk/JusPrinMenuWalk.app (bundle id io.jusprin.menu-walk).
     - walk/data: a copy of Kenneth's JusPrin2 data. It still exists and should be deleted later.
     - Mac app pid 33627 may still be running.
     - win/: insession.ps1, mlaunch.ps1, mshot.ps1, mact.ps1, mact.txt, plus menubuild.ps1 and start-task.ps1.
     - winshots/: the PNGs downloaded so far.
   - **VM scripts in C:\guitest:**
     - insession.ps1 (`-Script X -ArgLine`) runs a script in session 1 and waits.
     - mlaunch.ps1 (`-Model`) launches C:\src\JusPrin\.claude\worktrees\menu-trim\build\src\Release\orca-slicer.exe with `--datadir C:\guitest\menu-data`.
     - mact.ps1 reads C:\guitest\mact.txt, one action per line: `click x y`, `move x y`, `keys <SendKeys>`, `wait ms`, `shot name`. Shots go to C:\guitest\menu-shots\name.png.
     - Run it with: `./winssh.sh 'powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\guitest\insession.ps1 -Script C:\guitest\mact.ps1'`

4. Errors and fixes:
   - The old worktree build dir failed to configure (bundled Python under a two-entry prefix). Deleted it and configured fresh with CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/Users/kenneth/Projects/JusPrin/deps/build/arm64/OrcaSlicer_dep/usr/local, DEP_BUILD_DIR and JUSPRIN_PYTHON=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.
   - The first JXA menu dump timed out. Rewrote it to read properties in bulk.
   - Trailing File-menu separator on the Mac: fixed.
   - Duplicate Current Plate enabled on Home: reproduced (1→2 plates), then fixed.
   - Wrong Edit title lookup: fixed to use _L_CONTEXT("Edit","Menu").
   - clang-tidy:
     - Needed -y to install the pinned 22.1.8, and `-b origin/jusprin-dev --no-fetch`.
     - LZMA was not found; fixed with CMAKE_INCLUDE_PATH=/opt/homebrew/include.
     - The missing wx/event.h include was added.
   - On the VM, `&&` doesn't work in PowerShell; use `;`.
   - A `sleep` chain was blocked by the tool; use Monitor or run_in_background instead.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Mac verification is complete:
     - Harness: default 626, file-opening 97, stock 40 and classic-switch 85 checks pass.
     - Live AX reads were correct on Home, with a project open and after slicing.
     - File › Export G-code opened the save panel.
     - clang-tidy passes.
   - Windows:
     - The build succeeded (26.5 min), reusing C:/src/JusPrin/deps/build.
     - Screenshots on Home show the expected results:
       - File: New project, Open…, Open recent (grey), Save (grey), Version history… (grey), Import, Export, Exit.
       - Export: Project 3MF… Ctrl+Shift+S, Export G-code… (both grey on Home).
       - Title-bar menu: Edit, View, Print, Printer, Preferences Ctrl+P, Help.
       - Edit: Duplicate Current Plate is grey.
       - View: no IDEX or collision items.
       - Help: Ask AI…, Report a problem…, Show Configuration Folder, Check for Updates, About JusPrin.
     - Noted: the title bar shows "*Untitled" on Home after skipping setup.
   - The Windows harness has not been run yet.

6. All user messages:
   - Reply with quoted blocks:
     - Benchmark, Migrate, IDEX and collision: "Hi then."
     - Keyboard Shortcuts, Troubleshoot and Network Test: "hide them"
     - Three sliced-file exports: "Hide it."
     - Generic 3MF, DRC and "all plate sliced file": "I think we should just have 1 export for now, which is to export generic 3mf. oh we also need to give user a way to export gcode"
     - Preset Bundle: "Hide it."
     - Closing line: "re-examine the whole thing if necessary by launching the app afterwards."
   - AskUserQuestion answers: "Keep Project 3MF (Recommended)"; "Header exports G-code (Recommended)".
   - "launch the app so that I can check"
   - "commit to a feature branch. then run it on gcp jusprin-win-test and give me the screenshots for me to confirm"
   - "status?"
   - Standing constraints:
     - From CLAUDE.md:
       - Communicate like a colleague, in plain style.
       - Decisions start "Decision needed".
       - Commit or push only when asked; never commit submodules.
       - Ask before revert, amend or reset.
       - Builds: -j4, check the load first, one build per directory.
       - Use gcloud account ai-agent@tsdtechnology.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
       - Never share the Sentry token.
     - Don't drive another JusPrin instance.
     - Temporary docs stay untracked.

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Finish the Windows screenshots:
     - View print-home and printer-home.
     - Open a project (for example C:\src\JusPrin\.claude\worktrees\menu-trim\tests\data\20mm_cube.obj) and capture the File/Export, Edit (Duplicate enabled), Print and View menus with the project open.
     - Slice, then capture the header's print drop-down showing "Export G-code…" and File › Export with Export G-code enabled.
   - Optionally run the Windows shell harness (C:\src\JusPrin\.claude\worktrees\menu-trim\build\tests\shell\Release\shell_integration_harness.exe, which has Mesa beside it) through an Interactive task, to confirm the title-bar check.
   - Send the screenshots to Kenneth with SendUserFile, then call wrap_up.
   - Cleanup:
     - Quit the VM app (the orca-slicer process I launched).
     - Quit the Mac app copy (pid 33627) if Kenneth is done.
     - Delete scratchpad/walk/data (a copy of his data).
     - Consider whether to stop the VM. Ask, since another session uses it.

8. Current Work:
   I'm capturing Windows screenshots of the menus on the VM. The app is running on the VM, on Home: the window is at x 367–1553 and y 122–913, the File button is at (402,138) and the title-bar menu button at (450,138). Title-bar submenu rows are at y = 166 (Edit), 188 (View), 210 (Print), 232 (Printer), 283 (Help), with x ≈ 500. The latest batch hovered each submenu on Home and downloaded edit-home, view-home, print-home, printer-home and help-home to scratchpad/winshots. I've viewed edit-home, view-home and help-home, and all are correct. The plan step "Launch the app and capture each menu" is in progress; step 5, "Send the screenshots", is pending.

9. Optional Next Step:
   Continue the user's request "run it on gcp jusprin-win-test and give me the screenshots for me to confirm":
   - View print-home.png and printer-home.png.
   - Relaunch or open 20mm_cube.obj in the VM app (for example `mlaunch.ps1 -Model C:\src\JusPrin\.claude\worktrees\menu-trim\tests\data\20mm_cube.obj`, after closing the current app), and capture the menus with the project open.

content.text:
I committed the menu trim as e0ba67ea68 on a new branch, `claude/menu-trim` (not pushed). I then built it on the jusprin-win-test Windows VM and sent you 13 screenshots of the menus there. Every menu showed what we agreed, on Home, with a 20 mm cube open, and after slicing it.

**On Home, with no project open (screenshots 01–08):**
- **File:** New project, Open…, Open recent, Save, Version history…, Import, Export and Exit. Open recent, Save and Version history are greyed out.
- **File › Export:** only Project 3MF… (Ctrl+Shift+S) and Export G-code…, both greyed out.
- **Title-bar menu:** Edit, View, Print, Printer, Preferences and Help. Preset Bundle, Sync Presets and Plugins are gone.
